Biography & Background

Crafting reliable, scalable software with curiosity and precision.

I’m an enthusiastic software developer based in West Bengal, India. My journey involves turning complex logic into seamless digital experiences — whether architecting real-time APIs, crafting accessible interfaces, or deploying cloud workloads.

Active on GitHub under @PranSols, I actively experiment with modern frontend frameworks (React, Next.js, Tailwind), backend technologies (Node.js, Express, Python, PostgreSQL), and AI workflows.
